name: Snowy quiet morning
one_line: Fresh snow, blue shadows and a pale pink sunrise.
look_words: The morning after snow. White ground with soft blue shadows, grey-blue rock and weathered wood, snow-heavy fir trees, a sky that goes from pale blue to pink and cream at the horizon. The sun is very low, so shadows are long and gentle. Shapes are simple and rounded by the snow. Warm orange is kept for windows, fires and things to collect, violet for the goal; red means harm. The player wears deep blue, which reads cleanly against white. Motion is slow: falling flakes, chimney smoke, breath, footprints left behind. Sound is muffled. Avoid grey slush, dirty whites, hard black, heavy blizzard effects and bloom on the snow.

palette.name: snow morning
palette.notes: Snow shadows are blue, never grey. Exposure stays at 1 so the snow does not burn out. Text sits on the dark card.

look_wish: soft shading, a little haze, or none

upgrade.why: soft ground that remembers: footprints and sled tracks stay in the snow
pale morning air so far trees fade into the sky

music.mood: slow, glassy bells and a soft pad
music.notes: Very quiet; let the footsteps lead.

sound_feel: muffled; snow crunch, wind, a far-off crow
